Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the distribution of revenues under RCW 66.08.190 to the state, border areas, cities, and counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the distribution of revenues under RCW 66.08.190to the state, border areas, cities, and counties; amending RCW66.08.190; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 66.08.190 and 2012 2nd sp.s. c 5 s 8 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Prior to making distribution((s)) described in subsection(((2))) (3) of this section, ((amounts)) sufficient moneys must beretained to ((support)) fund the allotments under RCW 43.88.110 fromany legislative appropriation for ((municipal)) city research andservices. The legislative appropriation for such services ((must be inthe amount specified)) may not be less than the amount required underRCW 66.24.065. (2) Prior to making distributions described in subsection (3) ofthis section, the quarterly portion of the ten million dollar amountspecified in RCW 66.24.065 must be disbursed to local jurisdictions. (3)(a) When excess funds are distributed during the months of June,September, December, and March of each year, all moneys subject to p. 1 HB 2067distribution must be disbursed ((to border areas, counties, cities, andtowns as provided in RCW 66.24.065. (3) The amount remaining after distributions under subsections (1)and (2) of this section must be deposited into the general fund)) asfollows: (i) Threetenths of one percent to border areas under RCW66.08.195; (ii) Except as provided otherwise in (a)(iii), (iv), and (v) ofthis subsection, from the amount remaining after distribution under(a)(i) of this subsection: (A) Fifty percent to the general fund of the state; (B) Ten percent to the counties of the state; and (C) Forty percent to the incorporated cities and towns of thestate; (iii) During fiscal year 2016 and fiscal year 2017, from the amountremaining after distribution under (a)(i) of this subsection: (A) Sixtyfive percent to the general fund of the state; (B) Seven percent to the counties of the state; and (C) Twentyeight percent to the incorporated cities and towns ofthe state; (iv) During fiscal year 2018 and fiscal year 2019, from the amountremaining after distribution under (a)(i) of this subsection: (A) Sixty percent to the general fund of the state; (B) Eight percent to the counties of the state; and (C) Thirtytwo percent to the incorporated cities and towns of thestate; (v) During fiscal year 2020 and fiscal year 2021, from the amountremaining after distribution under (a)(i) of this subsection: (A) Fiftyfive percent to the general fund of the state; (B) Nine percent to the counties of the state; and (C) Thirtysix percent to the incorporated cities and towns of thestate. (b) The total annual distributions to local governments under thissubsection (3) may not be less than the amount required under RCW66.24.065.
